loginSubtitle: Sign in to your campaign hub
gmDemoDescription: Log in as the Game Master to control the world. Edit campaigns, create monsters, and guide the narrative.
playerDemoDescription: Log in as a player to create your character, interact with the story, and uncover secrets.
dashboardInvitePlayersDescription: Share this link with your players to have them join your campaign. The secret code will expire automatically in 2 hours for security.
charactersMustBeGM: You must be a Game Master to view this page.
charactersCreatedDesc: Your new hero is ready for adventure.
charactersDeletedDesc: The hero has been retired from the campaign.
charactersSavedDesc: The hero's sheet has been updated.
charactersRosterDesc: Manage all characters in your campaign: {campaignTitle}
charactersKickConfirmDesc: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this character from the campaign.
charactersNoCharacters: No characters have joined this campaign yet.
charactersDeleteConfirmDesc: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your character and remove your data from our servers.
charactersCreateDesc: You don't have a character in this campaign yet. Define your new hero to join the adventure.
charactersBackgroundPlaceholder: The detailed backstory of your character.
charactersPortraitDesc: A portrait will be generated for you upon creation.
charactersEditSheetDesc: Update your character's details and attributes here. Click save when you're done.
charactersPositionTooltip: Where does your character prefer to be in a fight? Backliners are cautious, frontliners are aggressive.
charactersResolveTooltip: How courageous is your character? Will they flee from danger or stand and fight to the end?
charactersAltruismTooltip: Is your character selfish or selfless? Will they prioritize their own gain or protect their friends first?
charactersDisciplineTooltip: How does your character approach problems? Are they reckless and impulsive, or careful and tactical?
charactersPreferredAttackTooltip: What is your character's go-to move in a fight? (e.g., 'Fireball', 'Charge with axe', 'Hide and snipe')
charactersMostPreciousTooltip: What single person, place, or thing does your character value above all else?
charactersMottoTooltip: A short phrase your character lives by or shouts in battle.
charactersConditionalRulesTooltip: Define specific rules for the AI to follow. These are high-priority instructions for specific situations.
charactersChooseArchetypeDesc: Select a starting archetype for your hero. This will determine your initial stats, skills, and equipment.
charactersFinalizeDesc: Give your new hero a name and a story. The background is pre-filled from the archetype, but feel free to customize it.
chatDescription: This is where players can communicate freely outside of the game and try to make plans.
itemsDescription: This is where you will create and manage magical items, equipment, and other artifacts within your campaigns.
monstersNoMatch: No monsters found matching your search.
monstersCreateDesc: Fill out the details for your new creature.
monstersEditDesc: Edit the details for your creature.
monstersObservationsPlaceholder: A brief description of the monster's appearance, abilities, and lore.
monstersPageDescription: Browse the bestiary of creatures that inhabit your world. View their stats, lore, and artwork.
placesDescription: This is where you will create and manage cities, dungeons, and other locations within your world.
loreDescription: Search the Hellfrost encyclopedia for rules, items, spells, and world information.
notFoundDescription: The page you are looking for seems to have gotten lost in the astral plane.
settingsProfileDesc: Manage your personal account details and preferences.
settingsEmailDesc: You cannot change your email address.
settingsAppDesc: Customize the look, feel, and functionality of the application.
settingsHandwritingFontDesc: Choose the font used for handwritten notes and titles.
settingsAiSettingsDesc: Configure generative AI features and API keys.
apiKeysDesc: Manage your generative AI settings and API keys here. Your key is stored in your browser's local storage, but the prompt is saved to the campaign.
apiKeysGeminiPlaceholder: Enter your Google AI Studio API Key
apiKeysGeminiDesc: Your key is stored locally in your browser. Get one from {link}.
apiKeysSystemPromptDesc: This is the core instruction given to the AI to define its role and behavior. You can tweak it to change the AI's personality or style.
apiKeysSavedToastDesc: Your Gemini API key and system prompt have been saved.
narrativeAudioNotSupported: Your browser does not support the audio element.
narrativeThinkingDesc: The Dungeon Master is crafting the next part of your story.
narrativeApiKeyNotFoundDesc: Please set your Gemini API key in the AI settings.
narrativeStoryUpdatedDesc: The next chapter has been written.
narrativeNotImplementedDesc: Manually adding a narrative post is not yet available. Please use the AI generation feature.
narrativeLastPromptDesc: This is the exact data that was sent to the Gemini model for the last generation. The prompt is now constructed on the backend.
narrativeRestartConfirmDesc: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete all narrative threads and comments for this campaign, restarting the story from the beginning.
narrativeErrorRedo: Could not redo the last generation.
narrativeResponsePostedDesc: Your actions have been recorded in the annals of history.
narrativeNoResponses: No player responses yet for the last post.
narrativeNotStarted: The story hasn't begun yet. The Game Master needs to post first.
narrativeYourTurnDesc: Describe your character's actions, thoughts, and dialogue.
narrativePublicResponsePlaceholder: What does your character do or say?
narrativeHiddenThoughtsPlaceholder: What is your character thinking? (optional, only visible to the GM)
integrationsDescription: This guide explains how to connect an external AI agent or tool to your campaign by interacting directly with the Firestore database using the Firebase Admin SDK.
integrationsGMsOnlyDesc: This page contains technical instructions for connecting external services. Proceed with caution.
integrationsHowTo: How to Read & Write Game Data
integrationsExampleScriptDesc: Use this Node.js script as a template for your agent to post new narrative content.
aiLogDescription: A chronological record of requests sent to the Gemini model and the responses received.
aiLogNoGenerations: No AI generations have occurred yet.
chooseRoleDescription: You have both Game Master and Player privileges. How would you like to enter?
registerDescription: Create a new account to start your adventure.
registerMissingFieldsDesc: Please fill out all required fields.
registerNoRoleDesc: You must select at least one role (GM or Player).
registerSecretCodeRequiredDesc: As a player, you must provide a secret code to join a campaign.
